confirmed_repairs: Revoked bearer/access-cookie sessions require current live persisted sid; inactive/unverified profiles and removed/suspended/pending memberships cannot retain profile-role authority.
Active membership role overrides stale profile role. Direct grants require current eligible membership. Exact requested tenant and both existing/requested role ceilings are checked.
Optional expected-user/tenant headers reject changed identity before endpoint effects, refresh rotation or logout revocation/cookie clearing. Conflicting bearer/cookie principals are rejected.
Refresh returns current verified user/tenant/role plus access token; concurrent rotation and reuse revocations are transactional.
Known rejected login accounting commits; unexpected issuance errors, including HTTP 4xx, roll back session/account side effects.
Legacy register is retired in favor of verified signup. Known failed signup mail does not claim delivery. Signup issuance failure rolls back account, membership and session.

Text assistant, voice assistant and campaign-test browser sockets use current sid/principal. Assistant tools recheck before effects. Campaign tests recheck before provider allocation and retain periodic monitoring.

Authorized Admin creation writes canonical active membership in the same transaction; failure rolls back the new profile. Admin role edits change active membership and refuse to manufacture missing historical membership.

Actual RBAC role edit is visible in Admin detail/list/effective-role filter. Historical assignment is separate from nullable effective_role and membership_status; explicit global platform policy is preserved.

Preserved intermediate 44-pass/one-NameError fixture run; not a final acceptance or application defect.

migration.policy: Add existing canonical verification and MFA-attempt fields with default false/zero and consistency checks, preserving prior values without inferred verification/membership. Short lock timeout. Data-retaining downgrade and idempotent re-upgrade.
migration.prerequisite: Operator reconciliation of historical verification/membership evidence before release. Missing verification defaults false; inconsistent previously provisioned values can intentionally fail validation.
migration.evidence_limit: migration-0059.txt records the first upgrade before the later attempts-field addition. Final authority/credential tests use completed0059. Root owns final clean-bootstrap acceptance.

wire_contract.semantics: Optional consistency only, never authentication or tenant selection. Empty expected tenant explicitly means tenant-less.

admin_directory.role: Membership assignment where present, historical profile assignment otherwise; not sufficient alone to prove access.
admin_directory.effective_role: Nullable eligible role from active/verified profile and current membership, with explicit global platform override.
admin_directory.membership_status: Current membership status, missing, or not_required for explicit platform policy.
admin_directory.role_filter: Current effective role; unavailable historical assignments do not match.

acceptance_limits: No deployment, live provider or customer action. Root integrated unit/security/PG union remains separate.
Coordinated frontend/backend rollout is required for expected-identity headers and refresh response. Legacy refresh families without a live bound sid require fresh login.
No automatic verification or membership backfill. Operators must use supported historical evidence; unavailable accounts remain unavailable.
Already admitted concurrent responses can still race browser Set-Cookie commits. Server admission/local state/effect guards do not provide browser cookie compare-and-swap.
Assistant checks run at message/non-token result/tool effect admission, not each audio byte/token. Campaign-test monitoring remains periodic plus provider-allocation-time validation.
A revocation after final authorization admission cannot atomically undo an external operation; durable unknown/no-resend receipt semantics remain required.
Existing Admin temporary-password flow is repaired; separate invitation delivery/acceptance remains absent.
MFA/passkey/reset evidence belongs to the separate credential slice and is not included in these 54 cases.
Next legacy authority containment and browser lifecycle validation are separately owned; this artifact does not claim those checks.
